registryBasis: The municipal SIGLON portal describes citizen access to municipal geospatial data. Its official ArcGIS REST service exposes a polygon layer “Base Cartográfica com Quadra, Lote e Loteamento” (layer 0), with fields OBJECTID, QUADR_C, LOTE_C, NOME_LOTE and SHAPE in SIRGAS 2000 / UTM 22S (EPSG:31982). A bounded exact-WUP point query requesting only OBJECTID, QUADR_C, LOTE_C and geometry timed out at 25 seconds with zero bytes; no feature/ID/geometry was returned or retained.
scopeLimits: Research uses official public sources and preserves the exact unchanged WUP locator. No owner, address, account, tax, personal-property, credential or token data requested or retained. No citywide completeness asserted.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the official ArcGIS layer will answer a bounded point query; whether QUADR_C + LOTE_C provide stable parcel identity; exact geometry coverage at WUP point; layer currency/authority relative to legal cadastral boundaries.
